clarification_questions: What is the bottleneck configuration? Please specify the emulated link bandwidth (e.g., Mbit/s), queue discipline/size, and any loss rate so the fixed bottleneck conditions can be fully defined.
What is the transfer workload? Please specify the file/data size (or duration) and the number of concurrent TCP flows per run, so flow completion time has a well-defined scope.
How many independent run-level replications per condition do you want, and are there any wall-clock time or cost budget constraints that should bound the pilot?
